topic.title: Affordable Housing / Viability / Vacant Building Credit
topic.source_contract: policy requirement, affordable tenure definition, threshold, gross and net floorspace, vacant building credit eligibility, benchmark land value, inputs, review mechanism, registered-provider route, nominations, legal agreement, funding, completions, occupation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A policy percentage is not an executed affordable-housing obligation.
A viability appraisal is not accepted merely because it was submitted.
Vacancy is not proof that vacant building credit applies.
Funding eligibility is not a funding award.
A registered-provider discussion is not a completed transfer.
A legal agreement is not occupied affordable housing.
Practical completion is not evidence of compliant tenure occupation.
No score or promotion is written without exact agreement, funding, completion and occupation evidence.
